stem.text: Which statement about ammonia or the ammonium ion is correct?

A.text: Ammonia gas is produced when an aqueous solution containing the ammonium ion is reacted with a strong acid.

B.text: Silver iodide is soluble in a concentrated aqueous solution of ammonia.

C.text: The ammonium ion has the same number of electrons as a methane molecule.

D.text: The square planar ammonium ion contains a dative covalent bond.
